title: ID0411731-DC/Si-D/BE-[QAqGBn] Converter error
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Converter error
Solution:
Root cause: Outlets were OOO because of COAP error which get resolved.
While testing simultaneous charging, plug 1 went offline. The test took place on 3/03/2025 at 12:12. This indicates problems with the converters. So simultaneous charging does not work on this UFC. Please investigate the issue and replace the necessary pieces.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0411731-DC/Si-D/BE-[QAqGBn] Outlet 1 out of order CRM:00798001952
additional_info.body:
Dear Ankita
Exactly. No active errors are showing and the charger is "working as it should". That's just the problem.
However, we went to test the site and simultaneous loading fails. If someone is already loading, the second client cannot start a loading session. We can also clearly see this from our system logs.
This issue has occurred in the past at other sites. Here we replaced the contactors or converters. It is the only solution to solve the problem.
So, please schedule an intervention to retest if needed, and replace the necessary parts.
With kind regards
Chloë D’hose
